# Identities for Tribonacci-related sequences

   Mario Catalani  Affiliation: Department of Economics, University of Torino  Affiliation: Via Po 53, 10124 Torino, Italy  Email: [mario.catalani@unito.it](mailto:mario.catalani@unito.it)

###### Abstract

We establish some identities relating two sequences that are, as explained, related to the Tribonacci sequence. One of these sequences bears the same resemblance to the Tribonacci sequence as the Lucas sequence does to the Fibonacci sequence. Defining a matrix that we call Tribomatrix, which extends the Fibonacci matrix, we see that the other sequence is related to the sum of the determinants of the 2nd order principal minors of this matrix.

## 1 Antefacts

Let SnS_{n} be the generalized Lucas sequence, also called generalized Tribonacci sequence, that is

    Sn+1=Sn+Sn−1+Sn−2,S0=3,S1=1,S2=3.S_{n+1}=S_{n}+S_{n-1}+S_{n-2},\qquad S_{0}=3,\,S_{1}=1,\,S_{2}=3.

SnS_{n} is sequence A001644 in [[2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib2)]. Let {α,β,γ}\{\alpha,\,\beta,\,\gamma\} be the roots of the characteristics polynomial x3−x2−x−1=0x^{3}-x^{2}-x-1=0 (for an explicit expression see [[1](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib1)]). Let us assume that α\alpha is the real root, β\beta and γ\gamma are the complex conjugate roots. We have α=1.8392286​…\alpha=1.8392286..., |β|=|γ|=0.737353​…|\beta|=|\gamma|=0.737353... (see [[3](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib3)]).

The Binet’s formula (see [[1](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib1)]) is

    Sn=αn+βn+γn,S_{n}=\alpha^{n}+\beta^{n}+\gamma^{n},

and the ordinary generating function A⁡(x)A(x) is

    A⁡(x)=3−2​x−x21−x−x2−x3.A(x)={3-2x-x^{2}\over 1-x-x^{2}-x^{3}}.

Let us consider the following matrix, that we might call Tribomatrix,

    𝐀=[110101100].{\bf A}=\left[\begin{array}[]{ccc}1&1&0\\ 1&0&1\\ 1&0&0\end{array}\right].

The eigenvalues of this matrix are {α,β,γ}\{\alpha,\,\beta,\,\gamma\}. Using the relationships between eigenvalues and coefficients of the characteristic equation we have

1. 1.     α+β+γ=1,\alpha+\beta+\gamma=1,
2. 2.     α​β+α​γ+β​γ=−1,\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma=-1,
3. 3.     α​β​γ=1.\alpha\beta\gamma=1.

By induction we get

    𝐀n=[Tn+1TnTn−1Tn+Tn−1Tn−1+Tn−2Tn−2+Tn−3TnTn−1Tn−2],{\bf A}^{n}=\left[\begin{array}[]{ccc}T_{n+1}&T_{n}&T_{n-1}\\ T_{n}+T_{n-1}&T_{n-1}+T_{n-2}&T_{n-2}+T_{n-3}\\ T_{n}&T_{n-1}&T_{n-2}\end{array}\right],

where TnT_{n} are the Tribonacci numbers (sequence A000073 in [[2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib2)])

    Tn=Tn−1+Tn−2+Tn−3,T0=0,T1=1,T2=1.T_{n}=T_{n-1}+T_{n-2}+T_{n-3},\qquad T_{0}=0,\,T_{1}=1,\,T_{2}=1.

Then

    tr⁡(𝐀n)\displaystyle{\rm tr}({\bf A}^{n}) =\displaystyle= Sn\displaystyle S_{n}     =\displaystyle= Tn+2​Tn−1+3​Tn−2,\displaystyle T_{n}+2T_{n-1}+3T_{n-2},

where tr⁡(⋅){\rm tr}(\cdot) is the trace operator.

From the generating function we get also immediately

    Sn=3​Tn+1−2​Tn−Tn−1.S_{n}=3T_{n+1}-2T_{n}-T_{n-1}.

Define

    Cn=αn​βn+αn​γn+βn​γn.C_{n}=\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}.

Then CnC_{n} is the sum of the determinants of the principal minors of order 2 of 𝐀n{\bf A}^{n} and we obtain

    Cn\displaystyle C_{n} =\displaystyle= 2​Tn+1​Tn−2+Tn+1​Tn−1−Tn2−2​Tn​Tn−1−Tn−1​Tn−3+Tn−22\displaystyle 2T_{n+1}T_{n-2}+T_{n+1}T_{n-1}-T_{n}^{2}-2T_{n}T_{n-1}-T_{n-1}T_{n-3}+T_{n-2}^{2}     =\displaystyle= −Tn2+2​Tn−12+3​Tn−22−2​Tn​Tn−1+2​Tn​Tn−2+4​Tn−1​Tn−2.\displaystyle-T_{n}^{2}+2T_{n-1}^{2}+3T_{n-2}^{2}-2T_{n}T_{n-1}+2T_{n}T_{n-2}+4T_{n-1}T_{n-2}.

The sequence CnC_{n} is sequence A073145 in [[2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib2)].

## 2 A Recurrence for CnC_{n}

We have

      −Cn−1−Cn−2+Cn−3=\displaystyle-C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}+C_{n-3}=     =\displaystyle= −αn−1​βn−1−αn−1​γn−1−βn−1​γn−1−αn−2​βn−2−αn−2​γn−2\displaystyle-\alpha^{n-1}\beta^{n-1}-\alpha^{n-1}\gamma^{n-1}-\beta^{n-1}\gamma^{n-1}-\alpha^{n-2}\beta^{n-2}-\alpha^{n-2}\gamma^{n-2}      −βn−2​γn−2+αn−3​βn−3+αn−3​γn−3+βn−3​γn−3\displaystyle\quad\quad-\beta^{n-2}\gamma^{n-2}+\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}+\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}+\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}     =\displaystyle= αn−3​βn−3​(1−α​β−α2​β2)+αn−3​γn−3​(1−α​γ−α2​γ2)\displaystyle\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}(1-\alpha\beta-\alpha^{2}\beta^{2})+\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}(1-\alpha\gamma-\alpha^{2}\gamma^{2})      +βn−3​γn−3​(1−β​γ−β2​γ2).\displaystyle\quad\quad+\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}(1-\beta\gamma-\beta^{2}\gamma^{2}).

Using relationships among roots we get

    1−α​β−α2​β2\displaystyle 1-\alpha\beta-\alpha^{2}\beta^{2} =\displaystyle= α​β​γ−α​β−α2​β2\displaystyle\alpha\beta\gamma-\alpha\beta-\alpha^{2}\beta^{2}     =\displaystyle= α​β​(γ−1−α​β)\displaystyle\alpha\beta(\gamma-1-\alpha\beta)     =\displaystyle= α​β​(γ+α​β+α​γ+β​γ−α​β)\displaystyle\alpha\beta(\gamma+\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma-\alpha\beta)     =\displaystyle= α​β​(γ+α​γ+β​γ)\displaystyle\alpha\beta(\gamma+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma)     =\displaystyle= α​β​γ​(1+α+β)\displaystyle\alpha\beta\gamma(1+\alpha+\beta)     =\displaystyle= 1+1−γ\displaystyle 1+1-\gamma     =\displaystyle= 2−γ.\displaystyle 2-\gamma.

Upon repeating the same calculations for the other quantities we get

    −Cn−1−Cn−2+Cn−3\displaystyle-C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}+C_{n-3} =\displaystyle= 2​αn−3​βn−3−αn−3​βn−3​γ+2​αn−3​γn−3\displaystyle 2\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}-\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}\gamma+2\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}      −αn−3​γn−3​β+2​βn−3​γn−3−βn−3​γn−3​α\displaystyle\quad-\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}\beta+2\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}-\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}\alpha     =\displaystyle= 2​Cn−3−αn−4​γn−4​α​β​γ−αn−4​βn−4​α​β​γ\displaystyle 2C_{n-3}-\alpha^{n-4}\gamma^{n-4}\alpha\beta\gamma-\alpha^{n-4}\beta^{n-4}\alpha\beta\gamma      −βn−4​γn−4​α​β​γ\displaystyle\quad-\beta^{n-4}\gamma^{n-4}\alpha\beta\gamma     =\displaystyle= 2​Cn−3−Cn−4,\displaystyle 2C_{n-3}-C_{n-4},

that is

    Cn−1=−Cn−2−Cn−3+Cn−4.C_{n-1}=-C_{n-2}-C_{n-3}+C_{n-4}.

So we got the recurrence

    Cn=−Cn−1−Cn−2+Cn−3,C_{n}=-C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}+C_{n-3},  (1)

with C0=3,C1=−1,C2=−1C_{0}=3,\,C_{1}=-1,\;C_{2}=-1.

In this way we obtain easily the ordinary generating function for CnC_{n}

    A⁡(x)=3+2​x+x21+x+x2−x3.A(x)={3+2x+x^{2}\over 1+x+x^{2}-x^{3}}.  (2)

## 3 A Recurrence for C2​nC_{2n}

     C2​n\displaystyle C_{2n} =\displaystyle= −C2​n−1−C2​n−2+C2​n−3\displaystyle-C_{2n-1}-C_{2n-2}+C_{2n-3}     =\displaystyle= C2​n−2+C2​n−3−C2​n−4+C2​n−3+C2​n−4\displaystyle C_{2n-2}+C_{2n-3}-C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-3}+C_{2n-4}      −C2​n−5−C2​n−4−C2​n−5+C2​n−6\displaystyle\quad-C_{2n-5}-C_{2n-4}-C_{2n-5}+C_{2n-6}     =\displaystyle= C2​n−2+2​C2​n−3−C2​n−4−2​C2​n−5+C2​n−6\displaystyle C_{2n-2}+2C_{2n-3}-C_{2n-4}-2C_{2n-5}+C_{2n-6}     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6+2​C2​n−2+2​C2​n−3\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}+2C_{2n-2}+2C_{2n-3}      +2​C2​n−4−2​C2​n−5\displaystyle\quad+2C_{2n-4}-2C_{2n-5}     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6+2​C2​n−2\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}+2C_{2n-2}      −2​(−C2​n−3−C2​n−4+C2​n−5)\displaystyle\quad-2(-C_{2n-3}-C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-5})     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6+2​C2​n−2−2​C2​n−2\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}+2C_{2n-2}-2C_{2n-2}     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6.\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}.

So we got the recurrence

    C2​n=−C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6,C_{2n}=-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6},  (3)

with C0=3,C2=−1,C4=−5C_{0}=3,\,C_{2}=-1,\;C_{4}=-5. The ordinary generating function is

    A⁡(x)=3+2​x+3​x21+x+3​x2−x3.A(x)={3+2x+3x^{2}\over 1+x+3x^{2}-x^{3}}.

## 4 Identities

Let n≥mn\geq m. Then

    Sn​Sn+m\displaystyle S_{n}S_{n+m} =\displaystyle= (αn+βn+γn)​(αn+m+βn+m+γn+m)\displaystyle(\alpha^{n}+\beta^{n}+\gamma^{n})(\alpha^{n+m}+\beta^{n+m}+\gamma^{n+m})  (4)    =\displaystyle= α2​n+m+αn​βn+m+αn​γn+m+αn+m​βn+β2​n+m\displaystyle\alpha^{2n+m}+\alpha^{n}\beta^{n+m}+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n+m}+\alpha^{n+m}\beta^{n}+\beta^{2n+m}      +βn​γn+m+αn+m​γn+βn+m​γn+γ2​n+m\displaystyle\qquad+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n+m}+\alpha^{n+m}\gamma^{n}+\beta^{n+m}\gamma^{n}+\gamma^{2n+m}     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+αn​βn​(αm+βm)+αn​γn​(αm+γm)\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}(\alpha^{m}+\beta^{m})+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}(\alpha^{m}+\gamma^{m})      +βn​γn​(βm+γm)\displaystyle\qquad+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}(\beta^{m}+\gamma^{m})     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+αn​βn​(Sm−γm)+αn​γn​(Sm−βm)\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}(S_{m}-\gamma^{m})+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}(S_{m}-\beta^{m})      +βn​γn​(Sm−αm)\displaystyle\qquad+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}(S_{m}-\alpha^{m})     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+Sm​(αn​βn+αn​γn+βn​γn)+\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+S_{m}(\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n})+      −αm​βm​γm​(αn−m​βn−m+αn−m​γn−m+βn−m​γn−m)\displaystyle\qquad-\alpha^{m}\beta^{m}\gamma^{m}(\alpha^{n-m}\beta^{n-m}+\alpha^{n-m}\gamma^{n-m}+\beta^{n-m}\gamma^{n-m})     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+Sm​Cn−Cn−m.\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+S_{m}C_{n}-C_{n-m}.

On the other hand let n<mn<m. Then everything goes the same with the exception of the next-to-last line, where we collect in the third sum αn​βn​γn\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}. Then the result is

    Sn​Sn+m=S2​n+m+Sm​Cn−Sm−n.S_{n}S_{n+m}=S_{2n+m}+S_{m}C_{n}-S_{m-n}.  (5)

## 5 Consequences

1. 1.  If we put n=n−1n=n-1 and m=1m=1 then we get    Sn​Sn−1=S2​n−1+Cn−1−Cn−2.S_{n}S_{n-1}=S_{2n-1}+C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}.
2. 2.  If we put m=nm=n we get    Sn​S2​n=S3​n+Sn​Cn−3.S_{n}S_{2n}=S_{3n}+S_{n}C_{n}-3.
3. 3.  Generally we have    Sn​Sn​m=Sn⁡(m+1)+Sn⁡(m−1)​Cn−Sn⁡(m−2).S_{n}S_{nm}=S_{n(m+1)}+S_{n(m-1)}C_{n}-S_{n(m-2)}.
4. 4.  If we put m=0m=0 we get    Sn2\displaystyle S_{n}^{2} =\displaystyle= S2​n+3​Cn−Cn\displaystyle S_{2n}+3C_{n}-C_{n}  (6)    =\displaystyle= S2​n+2​Cn.\displaystyle S_{2n}+2C_{n}.
5. 5.  For the cube we have    Sn3\displaystyle S_{n}^{3} =\displaystyle= Sn2​Sn\displaystyle S_{n}^{2}S_{n}     =\displaystyle= (S2​n+2​Cn)​Sn\displaystyle(S_{2n}+2C_{n})S_{n}     =\displaystyle= Sn​Sn+n+2​Sn​Cn\displaystyle S_{n}S_{n+n}+2S_{n}C_{n}     =\displaystyle= S2​n+n+Sn​Cn−Cn−n+2​Sn​Cn\displaystyle S_{2n+n}+S_{n}C_{n}-C_{n-n}+2S_{n}C_{n}     =\displaystyle= S3​n+3​Sn​Cn−3.\displaystyle S_{3n}+3S_{n}C_{n}-3.
6. 6.  For the 4-th power    Sn4\displaystyle S_{n}^{4} =\displaystyle= (Sn2)2\displaystyle(S_{n}^{2})^{2}  (7)    =\displaystyle= (S2​n+2​Cn)2\displaystyle(S_{2n}+2C_{n})^{2}     =\displaystyle= S2​n2+4​Cn2+4​S2​n​Cn\displaystyle S_{2n}^{2}+4C_{n}^{2}+4S_{2n}C_{n}     =\displaystyle= S4​n+2​C2​n+4​Cn2+4​S2​n​Cn.\displaystyle S_{4n}+2C_{2n}+4C_{n}^{2}+4S_{2n}C_{n}.   But also    Sn4\displaystyle S_{n}^{4} =\displaystyle= Sn3​Sn\displaystyle S_{n}^{3}S_{n}  (8)    =\displaystyle= (S3​n+3​Sn​Cn−3)​Sn\displaystyle(S_{3n}+3S_{n}C_{n}-3)S_{n}     =\displaystyle= Sn​Sn+2​n+3​Sn2​Cn−3​Sn\displaystyle S_{n}S_{n+2n}+3S_{n}^{2}C_{n}-3S_{n}     =\displaystyle= S4​n+S2​n​Cn−Sn+3​S2​n​Cn+6​Cn2−3​Sn\displaystyle S_{4n}+S_{2n}C_{n}-S_{n}+3S_{2n}C_{n}+6C_{n}^{2}-3S_{n}     =\displaystyle= S4​n−4​Sn+4​S2​n​Cn+6​Cn2.\displaystyle S_{4n}-4S_{n}+4S_{2n}C_{n}+6C_{n}^{2}.     Confronting Equation [7](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#S5.E7) and Equation [8](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#S5.E8) we get this other identity    2​Sn=Cn2−C2​n.2S_{n}=C_{n}^{2}-C_{2n}.  (9)

Identities for Tribonacci-related sequences

# Identities for Tribonacci-related sequences

Mario Catalani  Affiliation: Department of Economics, University of Torino  Affiliation: Via Po 53, 10124 Torino, Italy  Email: [mario.catalani@unito.it](mailto:mario.catalani@unito.it)

###### Abstract

We establish some identities relating two sequences that are, as explained, related to the Tribonacci sequence. One of these sequences bears the same resemblance to the Tribonacci sequence as the Lucas sequence does to the Fibonacci sequence. Defining a matrix that we call Tribomatrix, which extends the Fibonacci matrix, we see that the other sequence is related to the sum of the determinants of the 2nd order principal minors of this matrix.

1 Antefacts

# 1 Antefacts

Let SnS_{n} be the generalized Lucas sequence, also called generalized Tribonacci sequence, that is

    Sn+1=Sn+Sn−1+Sn−2,S0=3,S1=1,S2=3.S_{n+1}=S_{n}+S_{n-1}+S_{n-2},\qquad S_{0}=3,\,S_{1}=1,\,S_{2}=3.

SnS_{n} is sequence A001644 in [[2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib2)]. Let {α,β,γ}\{\alpha,\,\beta,\,\gamma\} be the roots of the characteristics polynomial x3−x2−x−1=0x^{3}-x^{2}-x-1=0 (for an explicit expression see [[1](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib1)]). Let us assume that α\alpha is the real root, β\beta and γ\gamma are the complex conjugate roots. We have α=1.8392286​…\alpha=1.8392286..., |β|=|γ|=0.737353​…|\beta|=|\gamma|=0.737353... (see [[3](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib3)]).

The Binet’s formula (see [[1](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib1)]) is

    Sn=αn+βn+γn,S_{n}=\alpha^{n}+\beta^{n}+\gamma^{n},

and the ordinary generating function A⁡(x)A(x) is

    A⁡(x)=3−2​x−x21−x−x2−x3.A(x)={3-2x-x^{2}\over 1-x-x^{2}-x^{3}}.

Let us consider the following matrix, that we might call Tribomatrix,

    𝐀=[110101100].{\bf A}=\left[\begin{array}[]{ccc}1&1&0\\ 1&0&1\\ 1&0&0\end{array}\right].

The eigenvalues of this matrix are {α,β,γ}\{\alpha,\,\beta,\,\gamma\}. Using the relationships between eigenvalues and coefficients of the characteristic equation we have

1. 1.     α+β+γ=1,\alpha+\beta+\gamma=1,
2. 2.     α​β+α​γ+β​γ=−1,\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma=-1,
3. 3.     α​β​γ=1.\alpha\beta\gamma=1.

By induction we get

    𝐀n=[Tn+1TnTn−1Tn+Tn−1Tn−1+Tn−2Tn−2+Tn−3TnTn−1Tn−2],{\bf A}^{n}=\left[\begin{array}[]{ccc}T_{n+1}&T_{n}&T_{n-1}\\ T_{n}+T_{n-1}&T_{n-1}+T_{n-2}&T_{n-2}+T_{n-3}\\ T_{n}&T_{n-1}&T_{n-2}\end{array}\right],

where TnT_{n} are the Tribonacci numbers (sequence A000073 in [[2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib2)])

    Tn=Tn−1+Tn−2+Tn−3,T0=0,T1=1,T2=1.T_{n}=T_{n-1}+T_{n-2}+T_{n-3},\qquad T_{0}=0,\,T_{1}=1,\,T_{2}=1.

Then

    tr⁡(𝐀n)\displaystyle{\rm tr}({\bf A}^{n}) =\displaystyle= Sn\displaystyle S_{n}     =\displaystyle= Tn+2​Tn−1+3​Tn−2,\displaystyle T_{n}+2T_{n-1}+3T_{n-2},

where tr⁡(⋅){\rm tr}(\cdot) is the trace operator.

From the generating function we get also immediately

    Sn=3​Tn+1−2​Tn−Tn−1.S_{n}=3T_{n+1}-2T_{n}-T_{n-1}.

Define

    Cn=αn​βn+αn​γn+βn​γn.C_{n}=\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}.

Then CnC_{n} is the sum of the determinants of the principal minors of order 2 of 𝐀n{\bf A}^{n} and we obtain

    Cn\displaystyle C_{n} =\displaystyle= 2​Tn+1​Tn−2+Tn+1​Tn−1−Tn2−2​Tn​Tn−1−Tn−1​Tn−3+Tn−22\displaystyle 2T_{n+1}T_{n-2}+T_{n+1}T_{n-1}-T_{n}^{2}-2T_{n}T_{n-1}-T_{n-1}T_{n-3}+T_{n-2}^{2}     =\displaystyle= −Tn2+2​Tn−12+3​Tn−22−2​Tn​Tn−1+2​Tn​Tn−2+4​Tn−1​Tn−2.\displaystyle-T_{n}^{2}+2T_{n-1}^{2}+3T_{n-2}^{2}-2T_{n}T_{n-1}+2T_{n}T_{n-2}+4T_{n-1}T_{n-2}.

The sequence CnC_{n} is sequence A073145 in [[2](https://arxiv.org/html/math/0209179v1#bib.bib2)].

2 A Recurrence for CnC_{n}

# 2 A Recurrence for CnC_{n}

We have

      −Cn−1−Cn−2+Cn−3=\displaystyle-C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}+C_{n-3}=     =\displaystyle= −αn−1​βn−1−αn−1​γn−1−βn−1​γn−1−αn−2​βn−2−αn−2​γn−2\displaystyle-\alpha^{n-1}\beta^{n-1}-\alpha^{n-1}\gamma^{n-1}-\beta^{n-1}\gamma^{n-1}-\alpha^{n-2}\beta^{n-2}-\alpha^{n-2}\gamma^{n-2}      −βn−2​γn−2+αn−3​βn−3+αn−3​γn−3+βn−3​γn−3\displaystyle\quad\quad-\beta^{n-2}\gamma^{n-2}+\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}+\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}+\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}     =\displaystyle= αn−3​βn−3​(1−α​β−α2​β2)+αn−3​γn−3​(1−α​γ−α2​γ2)\displaystyle\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}(1-\alpha\beta-\alpha^{2}\beta^{2})+\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}(1-\alpha\gamma-\alpha^{2}\gamma^{2})      +βn−3​γn−3​(1−β​γ−β2​γ2).\displaystyle\quad\quad+\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}(1-\beta\gamma-\beta^{2}\gamma^{2}).

Using relationships among roots we get

    1−α​β−α2​β2\displaystyle 1-\alpha\beta-\alpha^{2}\beta^{2} =\displaystyle= α​β​γ−α​β−α2​β2\displaystyle\alpha\beta\gamma-\alpha\beta-\alpha^{2}\beta^{2}     =\displaystyle= α​β​(γ−1−α​β)\displaystyle\alpha\beta(\gamma-1-\alpha\beta)     =\displaystyle= α​β​(γ+α​β+α​γ+β​γ−α​β)\displaystyle\alpha\beta(\gamma+\alpha\beta+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma-\alpha\beta)     =\displaystyle= α​β​(γ+α​γ+β​γ)\displaystyle\alpha\beta(\gamma+\alpha\gamma+\beta\gamma)     =\displaystyle= α​β​γ​(1+α+β)\displaystyle\alpha\beta\gamma(1+\alpha+\beta)     =\displaystyle= 1+1−γ\displaystyle 1+1-\gamma     =\displaystyle= 2−γ.\displaystyle 2-\gamma.

Upon repeating the same calculations for the other quantities we get

    −Cn−1−Cn−2+Cn−3\displaystyle-C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}+C_{n-3} =\displaystyle= 2​αn−3​βn−3−αn−3​βn−3​γ+2​αn−3​γn−3\displaystyle 2\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}-\alpha^{n-3}\beta^{n-3}\gamma+2\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}      −αn−3​γn−3​β+2​βn−3​γn−3−βn−3​γn−3​α\displaystyle\quad-\alpha^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}\beta+2\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}-\beta^{n-3}\gamma^{n-3}\alpha     =\displaystyle= 2​Cn−3−αn−4​γn−4​α​β​γ−αn−4​βn−4​α​β​γ\displaystyle 2C_{n-3}-\alpha^{n-4}\gamma^{n-4}\alpha\beta\gamma-\alpha^{n-4}\beta^{n-4}\alpha\beta\gamma      −βn−4​γn−4​α​β​γ\displaystyle\quad-\beta^{n-4}\gamma^{n-4}\alpha\beta\gamma     =\displaystyle= 2​Cn−3−Cn−4,\displaystyle 2C_{n-3}-C_{n-4},

that is

    Cn−1=−Cn−2−Cn−3+Cn−4.C_{n-1}=-C_{n-2}-C_{n-3}+C_{n-4}.

So we got the recurrence

    Cn=−Cn−1−Cn−2+Cn−3,C_{n}=-C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}+C_{n-3},  (1)

with C0=3,C1=−1,C2=−1C_{0}=3,\,C_{1}=-1,\;C_{2}=-1.

In this way we obtain easily the ordinary generating function for CnC_{n}

    A⁡(x)=3+2​x+x21+x+x2−x3.A(x)={3+2x+x^{2}\over 1+x+x^{2}-x^{3}}.  (2)

3 A Recurrence for C2​nC_{2n}

# 3 A Recurrence for C2​nC_{2n}

C2​n\displaystyle C_{2n} =\displaystyle= −C2​n−1−C2​n−2+C2​n−3\displaystyle-C_{2n-1}-C_{2n-2}+C_{2n-3}     =\displaystyle= C2​n−2+C2​n−3−C2​n−4+C2​n−3+C2​n−4\displaystyle C_{2n-2}+C_{2n-3}-C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-3}+C_{2n-4}      −C2​n−5−C2​n−4−C2​n−5+C2​n−6\displaystyle\quad-C_{2n-5}-C_{2n-4}-C_{2n-5}+C_{2n-6}     =\displaystyle= C2​n−2+2​C2​n−3−C2​n−4−2​C2​n−5+C2​n−6\displaystyle C_{2n-2}+2C_{2n-3}-C_{2n-4}-2C_{2n-5}+C_{2n-6}     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6+2​C2​n−2+2​C2​n−3\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}+2C_{2n-2}+2C_{2n-3}      +2​C2​n−4−2​C2​n−5\displaystyle\quad+2C_{2n-4}-2C_{2n-5}     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6+2​C2​n−2\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}+2C_{2n-2}      −2​(−C2​n−3−C2​n−4+C2​n−5)\displaystyle\quad-2(-C_{2n-3}-C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-5})     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6+2​C2​n−2−2​C2​n−2\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}+2C_{2n-2}-2C_{2n-2}     =\displaystyle= −C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6.\displaystyle-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6}.

So we got the recurrence

    C2​n=−C2​n−2−3​C2​n−4+C2​n−6,C_{2n}=-C_{2n-2}-3C_{2n-4}+C_{2n-6},  (3)

with C0=3,C2=−1,C4=−5C_{0}=3,\,C_{2}=-1,\;C_{4}=-5. The ordinary generating function is

    A⁡(x)=3+2​x+3​x21+x+3​x2−x3.A(x)={3+2x+3x^{2}\over 1+x+3x^{2}-x^{3}}.

4 Identities

# 4 Identities

Let n≥mn\geq m. Then

    Sn​Sn+m\displaystyle S_{n}S_{n+m} =\displaystyle= (αn+βn+γn)​(αn+m+βn+m+γn+m)\displaystyle(\alpha^{n}+\beta^{n}+\gamma^{n})(\alpha^{n+m}+\beta^{n+m}+\gamma^{n+m})  (4)    =\displaystyle= α2​n+m+αn​βn+m+αn​γn+m+αn+m​βn+β2​n+m\displaystyle\alpha^{2n+m}+\alpha^{n}\beta^{n+m}+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n+m}+\alpha^{n+m}\beta^{n}+\beta^{2n+m}      +βn​γn+m+αn+m​γn+βn+m​γn+γ2​n+m\displaystyle\qquad+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n+m}+\alpha^{n+m}\gamma^{n}+\beta^{n+m}\gamma^{n}+\gamma^{2n+m}     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+αn​βn​(αm+βm)+αn​γn​(αm+γm)\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}(\alpha^{m}+\beta^{m})+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}(\alpha^{m}+\gamma^{m})      +βn​γn​(βm+γm)\displaystyle\qquad+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}(\beta^{m}+\gamma^{m})     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+αn​βn​(Sm−γm)+αn​γn​(Sm−βm)\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}(S_{m}-\gamma^{m})+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}(S_{m}-\beta^{m})      +βn​γn​(Sm−αm)\displaystyle\qquad+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}(S_{m}-\alpha^{m})     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+Sm​(αn​βn+αn​γn+βn​γn)+\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+S_{m}(\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}+\alpha^{n}\gamma^{n}+\beta^{n}\gamma^{n})+      −αm​βm​γm​(αn−m​βn−m+αn−m​γn−m+βn−m​γn−m)\displaystyle\qquad-\alpha^{m}\beta^{m}\gamma^{m}(\alpha^{n-m}\beta^{n-m}+\alpha^{n-m}\gamma^{n-m}+\beta^{n-m}\gamma^{n-m})     =\displaystyle= S2​n+m+Sm​Cn−Cn−m.\displaystyle S_{2n+m}+S_{m}C_{n}-C_{n-m}.

On the other hand let n<mn<m. Then everything goes the same with the exception of the next-to-last line, where we collect in the third sum αn​βn​γn\alpha^{n}\beta^{n}\gamma^{n}. Then the result is

    Sn​Sn+m=S2​n+m+Sm​Cn−Sm−n.S_{n}S_{n+m}=S_{2n+m}+S_{m}C_{n}-S_{m-n}.  (5)

5 Consequences

# 5 Consequences

1. 1.  If we put n=n−1n=n-1 and m=1m=1 then we get    Sn​Sn−1=S2​n−1+Cn−1−Cn−2.S_{n}S_{n-1}=S_{2n-1}+C_{n-1}-C_{n-2}.
2. 2.  If we put m=nm=n we get    Sn​S2​n=S3​n+Sn​Cn−3.S_{n}S_{2n}=S_{3n}+S_{n}C_{n}-3.
3. 3.  Generally we have    Sn​Sn​m=Sn⁡(m+1)+Sn⁡(m−1)​Cn−Sn⁡(m−2).S_{n}S_{nm}=S_{n(m+1)}+S_{n(m-1)}C_{n}-S_{n(m-2)}.
4. 4.  If we put m=0m=0 we get    Sn2\displaystyle S_{n}^{2} =\displaystyle= S2​n+3​Cn−Cn\displaystyle S_{2n}+3C_{n}-C_{n}  (6)    =\displaystyle= S2​n+2​Cn.\displaystyle S_{2n}+2C_{n}.
5. 5.  For the cube we have    Sn3\displaystyle S_{n}^{3} =\displaystyle= Sn2​Sn\displaystyle S_{n}^{2}S_{n}     =\displaystyle= (S2​n+2​Cn)​Sn\displaystyle(S_{2n}+2C_{n})S_{n}     =\displaystyle= Sn​Sn+n+2​Sn​Cn\displaystyle S_{n}S_{n+n}+2S_{n}C_{n}     =\displaystyle= S2​n+n+Sn​Cn−Cn−n+2​Sn​Cn\displaystyle S_{2n+n}+S_{n}C_{n}-C_{n-n}+2S_{n}C_{n}     =\displaystyle= S3​n+3​Sn​Cn−3.\displaystyle S_{3n}+3S_{n}C_{n}-3.
6. 6.  For the 4-th power    Sn4\displaystyle S_{n}^{4} =\displaystyle= (Sn2)2\displaystyle(S_{n}^{2})^{2}  (7)    =\displaystyle= (S2​n+2​Cn)2\displaystyle(S_{2n}+2C_{n})^{2}     =\displaystyle= S2​n2+4​Cn2+4​S2​n​Cn\displaystyle S_{2n}^{2}+4C_{n}^{2}+4S_{2n}C_{n}     =\displaystyle= S4​n+2​C2​n+4​Cn2+4​S2​n​Cn.\displaystyle S_{4n}+2C_{2n}+4C_{n}^{2}+4S_{2n}C_{n}.
